title: Write the missing .cpp file
description:
This project has three files (see the tabs above the editor):

- `main.cpp` uses two functions,
- `mathx.h` **declares** them (says they exist),
- `mathx.cpp` should **define** them (say what they do), but it is empty.

Press Run now: you get a *linker* error, because the promises in the header are never kept. Fill in `mathx.cpp`.

The program should print `7 12`.
hints: Click the `mathx.cpp` tab. A definition repeats the header's line but has a body in braces instead of a semicolon.
